youtube_description:
Tom, Jon, and Drew are out and about at SnowCamp2019. In this second part of the three part series, the adventurers fight through knee deep snow over hills and valleys to recover the treestands from last deer season. Jon in his snowshoes has to sled out his Muddy stand fully assembled, while Drew chooses to backpack his River's Edge ladderstand. Downed trees up the ante as they fight to get back to warmth, Dick and the dog at Fort GreenBear.
